item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00340","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C15","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses nearly the same complete sentence structure and administrative mechanism: the identical six-category list of tax returns; a specified temporal scope; inspection during the Eighty-third Congress; access by a named Senate committee or its duly authorized subcommittee; a stated investigative purpose; incorporation of conditions in a Treasury decision approved the same date; and effectiveness upon Federal Register filing. The child principally substitutes the committee, return-period formulation, and Senate-resolution purpose. C15 and C08 are also strong precedents, especially for the Senate-resolution-purpose language, but C21 is closer in timing, congressional session, wording, and overall structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return","explanation":"Exact, distinctive enumeration of the covered tax-return categories."},{"child_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Interstate and Foreign Commerce, or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof","parent_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof","explanation":"The same operative authorization and congressional-session limitation, with only the committee changed."},{"child_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision1 relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date","parent_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision1 relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date","explanation":"Essentially verbatim incorporation of the same Treasury-controlled inspection conditions."},{"child_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","parent_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","explanation":"Exact closing effectiveness provision, reinforcing the broader textual match."}]}
